description: List the federal candidate committees that received contributions from the connected PACs of the 100 largest ICE and CBP contractors in the Pay-to-Play Register, for one FEC cycle (2024 for 2023-24, or 2026 for 2025-26, default 2026). Filter by committee name substring, state (two letters), party (REP, DEM or other, as the FEC lists it) or company name substring; limit 1-50 (default 20). Each committee name is as the FEC lists it, with party, office, state and district from the FEC, the net amount from the mapped PACs and the split by company; total and truncated give the full count. A listing records a contribution reported to the FEC; it is not a finding about the candidate, the contribution's purpose or any vote. No individual donor is named and no candidate profile is built. PAC money is company-wide, not tied to ICE or CBP work, and comes from voluntary contributions, not company treasury or contract money; the FEC's own words are quoted.

committee.description: Optional case-insensitive committee name substring, at most 80 characters; names are as the FEC lists them.

company.description: Optional case-insensitive company name substring, at most 80 characters, among the parents with a mapped PAC.

party.description: Optional party as the FEC lists it: REP, DEM or other.

state.description: Optional two-letter state or territory code, as the FEC lists it.

name: pay_to_play_committees
title: Find Contractor PAC Recipient Committees
